meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides The Roku Channel's home billboard; blur or hide posters; dim or hide rows; badges, footer
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless) on therokuchannel.roku.com (home) with desktop UA 1440x900 and iPhone UA 390x844, DOM captured after 7 seconds. The desktop capture is the React app; the phone capture held only the footer and one image (no content rows), so phone rules are not verified. Fixtures `real.html` (phone, footer only) and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts (text and titles stripped, needed ancestors only, `data-keep` on main, the account button and the search box).

LIVE desktop: `[data-test-id="page-billboard"]` 1, `.billboard-image` 1, `.roku-collection-item` 12 with their pictures, `.roku-collection-row` 1 (the other rows are lazy-loaded placeholders and appear on scroll), `[data-test-id="content-indicator-container"]` 10, `.nav-footer` 1 (also on phone). The original cookie, ad and app-banner rules matched nothing. Material UI classes (`css-xxxx`, `Mui*`) are generated and not used; rules use Roku's own `roku-*` classes and `data-test-id` attributes.

Choices: Poster artwork Show/Blur/Hide; Content rows Show/Dim/Hide.

NOT verified: the phone site beyond the footer, the details page and the live TV guide, lazy-loaded rows after scrolling, logged-in pages, regions other than the US.
